title: SDLC Task-Qualified Reference v1
description: A reference to an addressable entity in another task identified by TaskIdentifier. It combines the work-item-qualified task identity with the same semantic local selector used by SdlcTaskLocalReference.
$comment: SdlcTaskQualifiedReference has the form {TaskIdentifier}#<entity-kind>/<entity-id>, for example WI-0003|50000000#outcome/O-001. The host must resolve the task, verify the entity kind and ID, and enforce any same-work-item or dependency policy. This value is not globally unique across repositories; use SdlcReference for that scope.
